translations.literal: In the eighth year in combined land-and-water attack on Ji'an, rebels linked great rafts to ram the government pontoon bridge; Peiyuan directed war boats to intercept; a cannon wounded his chest; he bound the wound and fought in blood until all rafts were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In year eight at Ji'an rebels rammed the pontoon with great rafts; Peiyuan intercepted by boat, took a chest wound, bound it, and fought until every raft was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 尋克吉安，以總兵記名。

translations.literal: Soon Ji'an was taken and he was recorded for appointment as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: Ji'an soon fell and he was marked for regional commander.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，軍中大疫，培元病，回籍。

translations.literal: That winter plague broke out in the army; Peiyuan fell ill and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: That winter plague swept the army; Peiyuan fell ill and went home.

sentences.zh: 九年，石達開犯湖南，培元率千人扼桂陽，眾寡不敵，桂陽遂陷。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Shi Dakai invaded Hunan; Peiyuan led a thousand men to hold Guiyang; outnumbered, Guiyang then fell.
translations.idiomatic: In year nine Shi Dakai invaded Hunan; Peiyuan held Guiyang with a thousand men but was overwhelmed and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 尋率師船溯資水進援寶慶，會諸軍扼河而戰，數破賊，寶慶圍解，援浙江處州鎮總兵，仍留湖南領水師。

translations.literal: Soon he led war boats up the Zishui to relieve Baoqing; joining the armies he held the river and fought, repeatedly defeated rebels, the Baoqing siege was lifted; he was transferred to regional commander of Chuzhou in Zhejiang but remained in Hunan commanding the naval force.
translations.idiomatic: He then led boats up the Zishui to relieve Baoqing, held the river with allied forces, broke the rebels repeatedly and lifted the siege; he was named regional commander of Chuzhou in Zhejiang but stayed in Hunan with the fleet.

sentences.zh: 十一年，左宗棠進規浙江，立衢州水師，疏薦培元熟諳水陸軍事，請以署衢州鎮，募勇三千赴浙。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Zuo Zongtang advanced on Zhejiang and established the Quzhou naval force; he memorialized recommending Peiyuan as versed in land-and-water warfare, requesting him to act as Quzhou commander and recruit three thousand braves for Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year eleven Zuo Zongtang pushed into Zhejiang and formed the Quzhou fleet; he recommended Peiyuan for land-and-river command, acting Quzhou commander, and three thousand recruits for Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，培元率安武水陸全軍駐常山，控衢州北路，進江山，破大洲賊營。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi Peiyuan led the full Anwu land-and-water army to garrison Changshan, controlling the northern route to Quzhou, advanced on Jiangshan, and broke the Dazhou rebel camp.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi year one Peiyuan's Anwu army held Changshan, blocked Quzhou's north road, advanced on Jiangshan, and smashed the Dazhou camp.

sentences.zh: 賊竄龍遊，會攻之，賊酋李侍賢大股來援，培元與諸軍合擊，賊敗走。

translations.literal: Rebels fled to Longyou; in the joint attack rebel chief Li Shixian came in great force to relieve; Peiyuan and the armies combined to strike and rebels were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels slipped to Longyou; Li Shixian marched up in force; Peiyuan and allied columns beat them back.

sentences.zh: 二年，克湯溪、龍遊，斃賊酋陳廷秀，加提督銜，賜號銳勇巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the second year Tangxi and Longyou were taken and rebel chief Chen Tingxiu was killed; he was given brevet provincial commander rank and granted the title Ruiyong Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: In year two Tangxi and Longyou fell, rebel chief Chen Tingxiu was killed, and he received brevet provincial commander rank and the title Ruiyong Baturu.

sentences.zh: 迭克桐廬、富陽，會攻杭州，破賊於萬松嶺，攻清泰門外觀音堂，平其壘。

translations.literal: He successively took Tonglu and Fuyang, joined the attack on Hangzhou, defeated rebels at Wansongling, attacked Guanyintang outside Qingtai Gate, and leveled the stockades.
translations.idiomatic: He took Tonglu and Fuyang in turn, joined the Hangzhou assault, routed rebels at Wansongling, stormed Guanyintang outside Qingtai Gate, and leveled the forts.

sentences.zh: 城賊出戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Rebels sallied from the city to fight and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison sallied and was beaten back.

sentences.zh: 舁舢板入西湖，砲擊杭城。

translations.literal: Sampans were carried into West Lake and bombarded Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: They hauled sampans into West Lake and shelled Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠以衢州後路要衝，令培元返鎮，其所部水師留攻杭州。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang, because Quzhou's rear communications were critical, ordered Peiyuan to return to command; his naval detachments remained to attack Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo sent Peiyuan back to hold Quzhou's vital rear, leaving his fleet to finish the Hangzhou assault.

sentences.zh: 三年，杭州复。

translations.literal: In the third year Hangzhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou was retaken in year three.

sentences.zh: 培元丁母憂歸，遂不出。

translations.literal: Peiyuan returned home on his mother's death and never returned to service.
translations.idiomatic: Peiyuan mourned his mother and never returned to duty.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Guangxu seventeen.

sentences.zh: 湖南巡撫陳寶箴疏陳培元戰績，賜卹。

translations.literal: Hunan governor Chen Baozhen memorialized Peiyuan's battle merits and funeral gifts were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan governor Chen Baozhen cited his battles and the court granted mourning honors.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：自湘軍水師興，而後得平寇要領。

translations.literal: =Commentary= Commentary: From the rise of the Hunan naval force, the essentials for suppressing rebels were thereafter obtained.
translations.idiomatic: =Commentary= Commentary: Once the Hunan river navy arose, the key to suppressing the rebels was in hand.

sentences.zh: 後又設淮揚、太湖兩水師，平吳及浙西賴其力。

translations.literal: Later the Huaiyang and Taihu naval forces were also established; pacification of Wu and western Zhejiang relied on their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Huaiyang and Taihu fleets were added; pacifying Wu and western Zhejiang depended on them.

sentences.zh: 黃翼升、李朝斌當其任。

translations.literal: Huang Yisheng and Li Chaobin bore those responsibilities.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Yisheng and Li Chaobin held those commands.

sentences.zh: 其後設長江水師為經制，翼升與李成謀迭相更代，為東南重鎮。

translations.literal: Thereafter the Yangtze naval force was established as a standing institution; Yisheng and Li Chengmou alternated in command as a great southeastern stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangtze navy was then made a standing force; Yisheng and Li Chengmou alternated in command as the southeast's main river power.

sentences.zh: 平浙東專在陸師，故水師僅有衢州一軍。

translations.literal: Pacification of eastern Zhejiang depended chiefly on the land army, so the naval force had only the Quzhou contingent.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Zhejiang was won mainly by land troops, so only the Quzhou fleet represented the navy there.

sentences.zh: 劉培元亦彭、楊舊部，戰績可稱，用並列之。

translations.literal: Liu Peiyuan was also an old subordinate of Peng and Yang; his battle record was notable, and he is therefore listed together.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Peiyuan, another veteran of Peng and Yang, also earned a solid record and is listed here with them.
